newsitem.title: FINLAND: Valmet wins Korean drying equipment order.
newsitem.headline: Valmet wins Korean drying equipment order.

text.p: Finnish paper machinery maker Valmet Oy said in a statement on Thursday it had won an order for drying process equipment for a board machine rebuild at South Korean Dong Il Paper Mfg. Co. Ltd.'s Ansan mill.
It did not give the value of the order.

"The new drying process will enable Dong Il to improve the strength values of its recycled-fibre-based liner grades by more than 20 percentage units compared with competing products, and at the same time achieve a particularly smooth and glossy surface," Valmet said.
The rebuilt board machine is scheduled for start-up at the end of 1998, it said.
